carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition (high-luminance upper surface to shadowed lower edge) extending from the pectoral origin backwards.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple discrete, low-luminance oblong silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached to the lower lateral flank.
